author: Rob Gorden
text:
Sorry, that's BS!
Checking allows you to understand the relationship between food, exercise, illness, and impact on glucose levels.
It teaches you how to adjust your behavior to manage your diabetes.
You will find over time you will look less, as you learn more. 
They are a great tool. As a reference, I probably look 2x per hour, and when I feel "off".

author: Holly Ddav
text:
Mental health issues from looking at the app? Sounds like you’re female. Because that sounds like medical gaslighting. And that happens to women. 

I’d have two choice words for my providers if they pulled that nonsense. The first begins with an eff.  The second with an o. 

It’s 💯 normal to look at your app multiple times as you come to terms with the diagnosis. 

And consider downloading Gluroo to look at that if they’re monitoring your usage.
